task.instruction: Find a Mexico hotel with deals for December 25-26.

final_answer:
I found several Mexico City hotels with deals for Dec 25–26 (2 adults, 1 room). Your "Allow" reply didn't pick a hotel, so I haven't opened or booked any of them. Prices are per night and exclude taxes and fees.

- Hotel Diligencias (Historic Center, 8.2 Very Good): MYR 194, down from 299. Free cancellation. Taxes and fees add MYR 42.
- Hotel Metropol (Historic Center, 8.7 Excellent): MYR 278, down from 309. Free cancellation. Taxes and fees add MYR 60.
- Hotel More By Kavia (Reforma, 8.8 Excellent): MYR 412, down from 572. Free cancellation. Taxes and fees add MYR 80.
- Fiesta Americana Viaducto Aeropuerto (near the airport, 9.2 Wonderful): MYR 550, down from 786. Late Escape Deal with free cancellation and no prepayment. Taxes and fees add MYR 107.
- Fiesta Inn Ciudad de México Aeropuerto (near the airport, 8.4 Very Good): MYR 536, down from 669. Free cancellation and no prepayment. Taxes and fees add MYR 104.
- Casa Pani (Reforma, 9.3 Wonderful): MYR 683, down from 1,167. Limited-time Deal with 3 rooms left at this price. Taxes and fees add MYR 148.

Hotel Diligencias is the cheapest deal. Casa Pani has the biggest discount (about 41% off) and the highest rating. Tell me which one you want and I'll open it.

judge.rationale: The agent searched Booking.com for Mexico City, Dec 25–26, and listed hotels showing deal prices, e.g. Hotel Diligencias MYR 299→194 and Casa Pani MYR 1,167→683.
